name: Richards Group Inc.
summary: Richards Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and distributes packaging containers and healthcare supplies and products in North America. It operates through two segments: Packaging and Healthcare. It offers glass and plastic containers and closures. The Packaging segment distributes glass and plastic packaging products for food and beverage, as well as cosmetics industries. The Healthcare segment provides medical devices, consumables, and equipment for aesthetics, pharmacy, vision care, and other healthcare markets.
